map.如何使用特异度计算？: How do I use Specificity Calculation?
map.特异度计算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Specificity Calculation best for?
map.评估模型识别负类（特异度）的能力。: Evaluate the model's ability to identify the negative class (specificity).
map.特异度 TNR = TN/(TN+FP)×100%；假阳性率 FPR = FP/: Specificity TNR = TN/(TN+FP) x 100%; False Positive Rate FPR = FP/(TN+FP) x 100% = 1 - Specificity
map.特异度衡量负类被正确排除的能力，与召回率（灵敏度）构成 ROC 曲线的两个轴。筛: Specificity measures how well the negative class is correctly excluded, forming one axis of the ROC curve with recall (sensitivity). Screening scenarios may sacrifice specificity for high recall, but spam wrongly blocking legitimate mail is costly, so specificity should be prioritized instead.
map.特异度衡量模型识别负类的能力。: Specificity measures the model's ability to identify the negative class.
map.特异度 Specificity=TN/(TN+FP)，衡量模型正确识别负类的能力: Specificity = TN/(TN+FP), measuring the model's ability to correctly identify the negative class.
map.与灵敏度(召回)互补：灵敏度看重病不漏，特异度看重健康不误判。: Complementary to sensitivity (recall): sensitivity insists on not missing disease, specificity insists on not misjudging health.
map.医学筛查常要求高特异度以降低假阳性带来的过度检查。: Medical screening often requires high specificity to reduce over-testing from false positives.
map.TN=900, FP=30 → 特异度=900/930=96.8%，即健康人被: TN=900, FP=30 -> specificity = 900/930 = 96.8%, i.e. the share of healthy people correctly judged healthy; if FP rises to 100, specificity drops to 90% with more false positives.
map.特异度和精确率有什么区别？: What is the difference between specificity and precision?
map.特异度=TN/(TN+FP) 站在负类视角；精确率=TP/(TP+FP) 站在预: Specificity = TN/(TN+FP) views from the negative class; precision = TP/(TP+FP) views from predicted-positive. Their denominators differ, so do their focuses.
map.为什么筛查要重视特异度？: Why should screening care about specificity?
map.假阳性会引不必要的复查与焦虑、浪费资源；高特异度减少误报，但常与灵敏度权衡(卡阈: False positives trigger unnecessary rechecking and anxiety and waste resources; high specificity reduces false alarms, but often trades off with sensitivity (the two move opposite when setting the threshold).
